params.name: styles
params.description: Comma-separated icon styles to filter by. Common values include `solid` and `line`.

params.name: line_weight
params.description: Line weight in pixels (1-60) at 512-pixel rendering. Only meaningful for line-style icons.

params.name: limit_to_public_domain
params.description: When true, restricts results to icons released to the public domain.

params.name: thumbnail_size
params.description: Pixel dimension for returned thumbnail URLs.

params.name: blacklist
params.description: When true, applies the client's configured blocklist to results.

params.name: include_svg
params.description: When true, includes raw SVG markup in each icon result.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of icons returned per page.

params.name: prev_page
params.description: Cursor token returned by a prior response for backward pagination.

params.name: next_page
params.description: Cursor token returned by a prior response for forward pagination.
